About Cocoa Gems

Made to be shared.

Local baking, heartfelt details.

Cocoa Gems is a cottage bakery in Eureka, Missouri. The menu is made for celebrations, gifting, and any day that calls for something sweet.

Have dietary needs in mind? Dye-free and gluten-free options are available by request.
